caseStudy.problem: Schedules and appointments often arrive as screenshots. Entering each detail again is slow and makes overnight times and duplicate entries easy to miss.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: native iOS design, on-device parsing, review workflow and release preparation.
architecture: Apple Vision extracts text on the iPhone; Foundation parses dates and schedule rows.
SwiftUI presents editable drafts, original screenshots, warnings and a month calendar.
EventKit writes only after explicit review and Save. Local rules remember title, location and destination corrections.
TipKit persists contextual guidance independently of drafts; no account or app server is required.
decisions: Keep recognition and correction memory on the device.
Preserve local wall-clock times using named time zones and calendar arithmetic.
Require confirmation of uncertain suggestions and check for duplicate saves.
validation: 13 focused parser, time-zone, deduplication and preference tests pass.
Simulator UI automation verifies first launch and progressive import, review, editing and save guidance.
Product screenshots use invented appointments; physical-device acceptance remains separate.
Version 1.0 (4) passed Apple build processing; five real screenshots are complete and the first public release is Waiting for Review with automatic release after approval.
limitations: English text recognition and deterministic parsing do not cover every layout.
No share extension, background screenshot monitoring or automatic schedule reconciliation.
Optional address search sends query text to Apple Maps. Calendar and Reminders follow account sync settings.

readme.content:
# Screenshot to Calendar

From a screenshot. Into your day. A private iPhone app for turning captured schedules, appointments and tasks into Calendar events and Reminders.

Requires iOS 17 or later. Version 1.0 was submitted to Apple. The project is in pre-release.

## Bring it in, make it yours

Choose up to 20 screenshots from Photos or Files, paste text, or add an item manually. Apple Vision reads screenshots on the iPhone. Review dates, overnight times, the time zone and destination before saving. Uncertain suggestions stay in Needs review until checked.

A first-launch introduction and native TipKit guidance reveal import, review, remembered corrections and saving at the relevant stage. Rename a matching title or add a location, leave Remember enabled and tap Done to suggest those details next time. Dates are always read again.

Nothing is added to Calendar or Reminders until you tap Save. Duplicate checks protect against repeated imports. Preferences and drafts stay local. Optional place search connects directly to Apple Maps; Calendar and Reminders use the sync settings of your chosen accounts.

## Limits

English recognition and deterministic parsing do not understand every layout. Check all suggestions. There is no share extension, background screenshot monitoring, recurrence extraction or automatic reconciliation of changed schedules. Local preferences do not sync across devices.

[Setup & support](/screenshot-to-calendar/support) · [Privacy policy](/screenshot-to-calendar/privacy)
